brief:
Britain has still not responded to a 400-page legal petition documenting alleged colonial-era war crimes in Palestine, more than a year after its submission, according to Middle East Eye. The petition was filed by Britain Owes Palestine, a campaign group focused on Britain's historical responsibility in the region.

The absence of an official response marks a prolonged silence on the matter. The petition details specific allegations tied to Britain's role during the colonial period in Palestine. No timeline for government action or acknowledgment has been announced, leaving the campaign group and its supporters without clarity on when or whether the British authorities will formally address the claims presented in the document.

title: UK government ignores Palestine war crimes petition for a year
